clusters.name: Shopify Order Synchronization
clusters.reason: Includes core synchronization updates for Shopify orders, such as POS brokering, bulk transaction processing, and status auto-completion.

clusters.name: Shopify Integration Dashboard
clusters.reason: Provides central administration and health monitoring for Shopify integration components, including webhooks and SQS configuration.

clusters.name: Historical Order Migration
clusters.reason: Supports importing historical orders and transactions without impacting existing physical inventory levels.

clusters.name: Refunds
clusters.reason: Groups refund and return processes, including tax rate formatting, exchange order linking, and negative inventory adjustments for returns.

clusters.name: Inventory Adjustments
clusters.reason: Enables recording and tracking inventory variances across mobile applications and backend services.

clusters.name: Product Catalog
clusters.reason: Manages product metadata such as brand names, automated clearance categories, and indexing for multi-store visibility.

clusters.name: Preorder Management
clusters.reason: Updates to the preorder user interface for facility selection, shop connection visibility, and administrative permissions.

clusters.name: Preorder Product Audit
clusters.reason: Resolves data display issues in the product audit view related to Shopify listings and Solr query exceptions.

clusters.name: Transfer Order Management
clusters.reason: Focuses on internal inventory movements, including API updates for received dates and item status population.

clusters.name: NetSuite Integration
clusters.reason: Facilitates data exchange with NetSuite for cycle counts, transfer order acknowledgments, and exchange orders.

clusters.name: System Utility Library
clusters.reason: Common helper methods and backend services for CSV generation, AWS client management, and job log tracing.

clusters.name: System Logging
clusters.reason: Standardization of logging across integration components and order routing services for consistent observability.

clusters.name: Facility Configuration
clusters.reason: Updates for managing facility groups, product store associations, and contact mechanism deletions.

clusters.name: Customer Data
clusters.reason: Updates to customer-related attributes including geolocation mapping and contact information updates.

clusters.name: Financial Data Feeds
clusters.reason: Refactors financial feed filtering to use system properties for consistent date-based report generation.

clusters.name: User Interface Components
clusters.reason: General UI adjustments for better visibility, layout padding, and transaction sorting on management screens.
